narr: Monsoonal moisture resulted in reports of flash flooding in portions of southern Utah.
ev: A thunderstorm produced heavy rainfall in the high terrain around the town of Hildale, as well as within the town itself. Multi-Radar/Multi-Sensor (MRMS) 1-hour estimates showed around 1 to 2 inches of rainfall with this storm. Light to moderate rain continued for a while thereafter, with 3-hour MRMS estimates exceeding 2 inches of rainfall in spots. This rainfall ran into Short Creek, and resulted in a flow through the town of Hildale, though the flow was not significant enough to overtop any road crossings within town.

A thunderstorm produced heavy rainfall over the course of an hour or so in the high terrain northwest of the town of Leeds, UT. Multi-Radar/Multi-Sensor 1-hour estimates show around 1.5 to 2.5 inches of rainfall with this storm. An initial report was received of water over the bridge at Red Cliffs Campground as water flowed out of Water Canyon and through Harrisburg Creek. A short time later, a video was found on Twitter showing water flowing through the campground and overtopping the access bridge.
lsr: MINOR FLOODING IN THE TOWN OF HILDALE. SHORT CREEK FLOWED BUT DID NOT OVERTOP ROAD CROSSINGS IN TOWN.
